第82章 李青山上门来嘲讽-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“我孙子？李青山那小瘪犊子还是我孙子呢，他怎么能上山打到野物，你俩儿子怎么就不行？”

李老屯怒斥道。

“怎么跟爹说话的？给爹道歉！”

李二奎见状，也是开口训斥自家婆娘道。

李二奎家的婆娘见状，一阵委屈顿时涌上心头，低着头坐回了椅子上，不再说话，自家男人都不挺着自己了，自己还能硬气啥呢？

当初早知道如此，还不如嫁给别人呢！

“爷，要我看，李青山这小子之所以能两次都打了这么多野物，肯定沾了咱们老李家祖坟的光，这小子是把咱们老李家祖坟的福泽都吃掉了，不然怎么可能打这么多野物。”

“所以，他的那些野物啊，得分给咱们一些才是。”

李青书突然道，桌子上正啃细粮的老李家人，齐刷刷朝着粮食看了过去。

这说法，似乎有些道理啊。

“咳咳！”

就在这时，李老屯的婆娘干咳两声，李老屯脸上也流露出一抹不悦道：“行了，李青山那小子不会因为这个给咱们肉的。”

主要是这事情要是被扯开了，村里一些知道内情的老人，说不得要把当年的秘密公布于众，那自己这张老脸？

还要不要的。

老李家再次沉默了。

“呦，一家子在这干嘛呢，一个个低着头，闷闷不乐的？”

就在这时。

李青山的身影突然从院子外走了进来，脸上还带着一抹笑意，望着院子里正在吃粗粮玉米面和地瓜的老李家人，手中还用双耳陶土盆装了一盆满满当当的狍子肉，蘑菇和豆腐块，鸡蛋。

一进来，那小味道。

一下子传开了，真是让人挠心啊。

“李，李青山，你来我们家干什么？”李青书见到李青山后脖子一缩，似乎都被李青山给打出后遗症来了。

“哎呦，青山啊，你这是来给我们家送肉来了？我就说嘛，青山是个好孩子，这打断了骨头还连着筋呢，咱们都是老李家的人，哪能因为一点小事情就闹僵了呢？”

"My grandson? Li Qingshan's little little calf is still my grandson. How can he go up the mountain and hunt wild animals? Why can't you two sons?"

Li Laotun scolded angrily.

"Why are you talking to dad? Apologize to dad!"

When Li Erkui saw this, he also scolded his mother-in-law.

When the mother-in-law of Li Erkui's family saw this, a wave of grievances suddenly welled up in her heart. She lowered her head and sat back on the chair. She stopped talking. The men in her family didn't support her anymore, so what else could she do to be tough?

If I had known this, I might as well have married someone else!

"Sir, let me see. The reason why this guy Li Qingshan was able to kill so many wild animals twice must be because of the ancestral graves of our old Li family. This guy has eaten up all the blessings of our ancestral graves of the old Li family. Otherwise, how could he have hunted so many wild animals."

"So, those wild animals of his should be given some points to us."

Li Qingshu suddenly said, and the old Li family who were eating fine grains on the table all looked at the grains.

This statement seems to make some sense.

"Ahem!"

At this moment, Li Laotun's mother-in-law coughed twice, and Li Laotun's face showed a hint of displeasure and said: "Okay, that guy Li Qingshan won't give us meat because of this."

The main thing is that if this matter is pulled out, some old people in the village who know the inside story will not be able to reveal the secrets of the year to the public. What about my old face?

Do you still want it?

The old Li family was silent again.

"Hey, what are the whole family doing here, all with their heads down and looking unhappy?"

Just then.

Li Qingshan's figure suddenly walked in from outside the yard, with a smile on his face. He looked at the old Li family who were eating whole grain cornmeal and sweet potatoes in the yard. He also filled a pot full of roe deer meat, mushrooms, tofu cubes, and eggs in a double-ear clay pot.

As soon as you come in, there's that little smell.

It spread all of a sudden, which is really heartbreaking.

"Li, Li Qingshan, why did you come to our house?" Li Qingshu shrank his neck when he saw Li Qingshan, as if he was suffering from the sequelae of Li Qingshan.

"Hey, Qingshan, are you here to bring meat to our family? Let me just say, Qingshan is a good boy. His bones are broken but his tendons are still attached. We are all from the Lao Li family, how can we get into a fight over a trivial matter?"
